title: stelis robustior
intro: Stelis robustior, commonly known as Robust Stelis, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory tract infections, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Stelis robustior include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the main compounds contributing to its therapeutic effects.
